q: For the statement that the sum of the first n terms of the progression 2, 3, 4, … equals \( \dfrac{n}{2}[2\cdot2 + (n-1)1] \), what is the base case n = 1 on the right side?
e:
Solution:

When n = 1 the right side is 1/2 × 2×2 = 2, which matches the first term.

e:
Solution:

The inductive step proves that if P(k) is true, then P(k+1) is true.
